title: CtlLogsResponse
description: The tail of one tenant log, bounded (`lines` ≤ 5000) and REDACTED before it leaves the daemon: the key-shaped regex `(API_KEY[A-Z_]*|KEY|SECRET|PASSWORD|TOKEN|DSN|AUTH)=…`, `|sig=<hex>` tails, and every value seeded from the tenant's current AND historical secret files (`*.bak-*`, the revocation ledger) are replaced with `<redacted>`. `redacted` is a constant `true` — a log endpoint that could ever answer unredacted would need a different schema. The file's on-disk path is deliberately NOT returned.

truncated.description: True when the log has more lines than `requested` (the tail was cut) OR a single line exceeded the 16 KiB per-line cap and was cut.
